what_to_detect: An entity holding +1/+1 or -1/-1 counters whose power and toughness differ from its base by the counters' net amount.
near_miss: An entity holding only counters that change no characteristic, its counter P/T boost zero.

what_to_detect: An entity holding a keyword counter that has that keyword.
near_miss: An entity holding only counters that grant no keyword.

what_to_detect: The rad-counter trigger of a player with rad counters fires at the beginning of that player's precombat main phase; its resolution mills that many cards and removes a rad counter and 1 life per nonland card milled.
near_miss: A player with no rad counters begins a precombat main phase and no rad trigger is evaluated.
record_fields: trigger record of the engine-made command-zone Radiation effect (no sidecar line)

what_to_detect: A creature equipped by an Equipment with hone counters, its power raised by one per hone counter.
near_miss: A creature equipped by an Equipment with no hone counters.
record_fields: gen-3 card counters on the Equipment

what_to_detect: A resolution whose effect half holds a zone_change of a permanent that carried counters in the pre-resolution snapshot, the object arriving in its new zone with none.
near_miss: A zone_change of a permanent with no counters, or a permanent with counters that phases out without changing zones.

what_to_detect: A resolution putting a +1/+1 or -1/-1 counter on a permanent that holds counters of the opposite kind, after which counter_change events remove one of each kind in pairs.
near_miss: A +1/+1 or -1/-1 counter put on a permanent holding none of the opposite kind.

what_to_detect: A resolution that puts a counter on a permanent already at the maximum a static allows for that counter kind, the count left at the maximum.
near_miss: A counter put on a permanent below its maximum, which raises the count.

what_to_detect: A resolution whose effect half moves a permanent onto the battlefield and holds a counter_change on that same permanent as it enters, the counters put on by the player it enters under.
near_miss: A resolution moving a permanent onto the battlefield with no counter_change on it.
record_fields: counter_change events on the same subject
rewrite records of counter_change met by a counter replacement

what_to_detect: A resolution of a leaves-the-battlefield trigger putting on another object the counters its leaving source had: counter_change deltas equal to the leaver's last-known counters.
near_miss: Such a trigger whose source left with no counters, putting none.
record_fields: state last-known counters of the leaver

what_to_detect: A resolution of an ability with a sacrifice cost putting on another object the counters the sacrificed object had: counter_change deltas equal to the sacrificed object's counters.
near_miss: Such an ability whose sacrificed object had no counters, putting none.
record_fields: state counters of the sacrificed object
